definitions.full: H5894. ir עִיר noun masculine waking, or wakeful, one , i.e. angel (√ עיר , compare Syriac wake , waking (PS 2843 ), Jewish-Aramaic עִיר , Late Hebrew עֵיר adjective awake ); — absolute ׳ע Dan 4:10 ; 4:20 ; plural absolute עִירִין 4:14 ; Aq Symm. ἐγρήγορος ; compare Charles Enoch i. 5 ; xxxix. 12; also p. 356 Dr on the passage ; doubtful is the connection with Phoenician Zophesemim (Euseb Praep. Evang. 10 ), i.e. שמים צפי watchers of heaven , as keeping watch over or spying out (Zim KAT 3. 629 Jerem Atim Licht d. AO 63 ). עֵלָּא עַל, see עלה . עִלָּה see I. עלל .
